ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם רָצָה לִדְאֹג לֶעָתִיד שֶׁל בְּנוֹ יִצְחָק.
ideas.children_en: Abraham, now old, told his trusted servant to find a wife for Isaac from his family outside the land of Canaan. The servant promised to do exactly that.

ideas.children_he: חָשׁוּב לְכַבֵּד אֶת רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם בְּהַחְלָטוֹת עַל חַיָּיו.
ideas.children_en: The servant worried about what to do if the woman would not come, but Abraham said Isaac must stay in the land God gave him and not return.

ideas.children_he: הָעֶבֶד בִּקֵּשׁ עֶזְרָה וְחִפֵּשׂ סִימָן לְטוּב לֵב.
ideas.children_en: The servant traveled with camels and gifts, prayed, and waited by the well where women come to draw water, hoping to find the right wife for Isaac.

ideas.children_he: רִבְקָה עָזְרָה גַּם לָאִישׁ וְגַם לַגְּמַלִּים. זֶהוּ חֶסֶד אֲמִתִּי.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca, a kind and beautiful girl from Nahor's family, came to draw water. She gave water to the servant and his camels.

ideas.children_he: מַעֲשֶׂה טוֹב יָכוֹל לְלַמֵּד הַרְבֵּה עַל אָדָם.
ideas.children_en: The servant admired Rebecca and asked about her family and home. When he learned she was from a good family, he thanked God for guiding him.

ideas.children_he: רִבְקָה שִׁתְּפָה אֶת מִשְׁפַּחְתָּהּ בְּמָה שֶׁקָּרָה.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca ran home to tell her family about the meeting. Her brother Laban quickly went to meet the servant by the well.
Laban welcomed the servant in, made place for him and his camels, and helped with their needs. The servant explained his mission before eating.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמְּבַקְּשִׁים עֶזְרָה, חָשׁוּב לְהַסְבִּיר בְּבֵרוּר אֶת הַמַּטָּרָה.
ideas.children_en: The servant told Laban about Abraham's blessing, about Isaac, and about the rule to find a wife for Isaac from their family, not from the Canaanites.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים אֲנָשִׁים צְרִיכִים אֱמוּנָה כְּדֵי לָצֵאת לַדֶּרֶךְ.
ideas.children_en: The servant asked what if the woman won’t come. Abraham said God will send an angel to help find the right wife from his family home.

ideas.children_he: הָעֶבֶד חִפֵּשׂ בְּרִבְקָה נְדִיבוּת וְלֹא רַק יוֹפִי.
ideas.children_en: The servant prayed to God to show him the woman who offers water to him and his camels. Then Rebecca came and did exactly that.
The servant asked Rebecca's family if they agree to give her to Isaac, and they said yes because they saw this was God’s will.
The servant thanked God for success, bowed down, and gave gifts to Rebecca and her family to honor the marriage plan.

ideas.children_he: פְּרֵדָה מֵהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה לִקְרַאת חַיִּים חֲדָשִׁים יְכוֹלָה לִהְיוֹת קָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: After resting, the servant wanted to leave soon with Rebecca to his master. Her family wanted to prepare her before she left.

ideas.children_he: בִּרְכַּת הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה מְלַוָּה אֶת רִבְקָה לַדֶּרֶךְ.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca’s family sent her with Abraham’s servant, her nurse, and helpers on the journey, blessing her to be successful and good.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים צָרִיךְ אֹמֶץ כְּדֵי לַעֲזֹב מָקוֹם מֻכָּר.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca left with her nurse and girls who came to help her. The servant watched over her carefully.

ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק יָצָא לַשָּׂדֶה וְרָאָה אוֹרְחִים מַגִּיעִים.
ideas.children_en: Isaac was in the Negev. In the evening, he walked in the field and saw the camels coming with Rebecca and the servant.

ideas.children_he: הַפְּגִישָׁה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה שֶׁל רִבְקָה וְיִצְחָק הָיְתָה רֶגַע מְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca saw Isaac and fell from the camel. She asked who he was, and the servant said it was Isaac, so she covered her face with a veil.

ideas.children_he: אַהֲבָה וְקִרְבָה יְכוֹלוֹת לְהָבִיא נֶחָמָה אַחֲרֵי אֲבֵדָה.
ideas.children_en: The servant told Isaac all he did and how God helped. Isaac married Rebecca, loved her, and found comfort after his mother died.
